name: Silk Developers (Pvt) Ltd
description: Silk Developers (Pvt) Ltd is a Lahore-based real estate development house founded in 1998, known for large-scale gated residential communities along DHA and Raiwind Road. The company is registered with the Lahore Development Authority (LDA) and has delivered over 14 completed housing and apartment projects across Lahore, with a reputation for on-time possession and in-house facilities management post-handover.

name: Metro Horizon Builders
description: Metro Horizon Builders is a Karachi-headquartered developer established in 2005, specializing in high-rise residential towers and mixed-use commercial developments along Clifton and Shahrah-e-Faisal. The company is registered with the Sindh Building Control Authority (SBCA) and is recognized for waterfront-adjacent apartment towers with in-house retail podiums.

name: Capital Heights Group
description: Capital Heights Group is an Islamabad-based developer founded in 2010, focused on planned residential enclaves and mid-rise apartment blocks near the Islamabad Expressway and I-8/I-10 sectors. The group is registered with the Capital Development Authority (CDA) and is known for plot-and-house hybrid schemes aimed at overseas Pakistani investors.

name: Al-Noor Estates & Developers
description: Al-Noor Estates & Developers is a Rawalpindi-based real estate firm operating since 2001, with a portfolio spanning residential plot schemes along Adiala Road and commercial plazas on Murree Road. The company is registered with the Rawalpindi Development Authority (RDA) and has built a client base largely through referral-driven sales in twin-city (Rawalpindi-Islamabad) markets.
